title: Progressive Random Convolutions for Single Domain Generalization (with RandConv, arXiv 2007.13003)
mechanism: Stacked small random convolutions (with deformable offsets and affine) as augmentation: texture and contrast diversity while keeping shape.
evidence: Outperforms SDG baselines (abstract). From GIN-IPA Table II: plain RandConv lost to GIN-IPA on all three medical tasks (e.g. prostate 57.74 vs 70.37).
adaptation: Kernel 3, at most 3 stacked layers, mixed 50/50 with the original, so cracks survive.
min_experiment: PF+RandConv vs PF+GIN-IPA, 5 seeds; E1 relF1@2. Mainly a benchmark baseline; kill if below GIN-IPA.
